    The functor L from a Kronecker pair #

    A Kronecker pair on a finite quiver D consists of two representations P and Q₀ with finite-dimensional spaces, which are bricks and have disjoint supports, together with two families z₁, z₂ of maps z_α : P(i) → Q₀(j) for the arrows α : i → j that are linearly independent as tuples (two independent extension classes in Ext¹(P, Q₀)).

    For a finite-dimensional Kronecker module T = (V, W; a, b), L(T)(i) = (Q₀(i) ⊗ W) × (P(i) ⊗ V) with arrow maps [[Q₀(α) ⊗ 1, z₁,α ⊗ a + z₂,α ⊗ b], [0, P(α) ⊗ 1]], and L(g, h) = (1 ⊗ h) × (1 ⊗ g).

    structure LargeIndecomposable.Covering.KroneckerPair (k : Type u) [Field k] (D : FinQuiver) :
    Type (u + 1)

    A Kronecker pair on a finite quiver D.

    • P : Rep k D

      The brick receiving V.

    • Q₀ : Rep k D

      The brick receiving W.

    • finP (i : D.V) : FiniteDimensional k ↑(self.P.obj i)
    • finQ (i : D.V) : FiniteDimensional k ↑(self.Q₀.obj i)
    • disjoint (i : D.V) : Subsingleton ↑(self.P.obj i) ∨ Subsingleton ↑(self.Q₀.obj i)
    • brickP (f : self.P ⟶ self.P) : ∃ (c : k), ∀ (i : D.V), ModuleCat.Hom.hom (f.app i) = c • LinearMap.id
    • brickQ (f : self.Q₀ ⟶ self.Q₀) : ∃ (c : k), ∀ (i : D.V), ModuleCat.Hom.hom (f.app i) = c • LinearMap.id
    • z₁ (α : D.A) : ↑(self.P.obj (D.src α)) →ₗ[k] ↑(self.Q₀.obj (D.tgt α))

      The first extension tuple.

    • z₂ (α : D.A) : ↑(self.P.obj (D.src α)) →ₗ[k] ↑(self.Q₀.obj (D.tgt α))

      The second extension tuple.

    • indep (c₁ c₂ : k) : (∀ (α : D.A), c₁ • self.z₁ α + c₂ • self.z₂ α = 0) → c₁ = 0 ∧ c₂ = 0
    • nonzeroP : ∃ (i : D.V), Nontrivial ↑(self.P.obj i)
    • nonzeroQ : ∃ (i : D.V), Nontrivial ↑(self.Q₀.obj i)

                  structure LargeIndecomposable.Covering.PairCoveringData (k : Type u) [Field k] (A : Type u) [Ring A] [Algebra k A] :
                  Type (u + 1)

                  Covering data: the finite part of a Galois covering with torsion-free group, a Kronecker pair on it whose supports cover D, and a presentation kQ → A whose kernel acts by zero on the push-downs p_*L(T), T ∈ D_fin.

                  • D : FinQuiver

                    The full subquiver of the covering on the support.

                  • Q : FinQuiver

                    The quiver of the presentation.

                  • p : self.D.Hom self.Q

                    The restriction of the covering map.

                  • locInj : self.p.LocallyInjective
                  • C : CoverData self.p

                    The group action of the covering.

                  • K : KroneckerPair k self.D

                    The Kronecker pair.

                  • supp (i : self.D.V) : Nontrivial ↑(self.K.P.obj i) ∨ Nontrivial ↑(self.K.Q₀.obj i)
                  • π : FinQuiver.PathAlgebra k self.Q →ₐ[k] A

                    The presentation.

                  • surj : Function.Surjective ⇑self.π
                  • kills (T : Dfin k) (z : FinQuiver.PathAlgebra k self.Q) : self.π z = 0 → (Rep.pdAct self.p (self.K.functor.obj ((DfinToKfin k).obj T))) z = 0
